analysis.geometry_hash_convention: sha256 of UTF-8 compact JSON ordered [latitude,longitude] arrays; finite binary64 numbers converted with float.hex(), signed zero normalized; no rounding, sorting, simplification or removal of repeated vertices
analysis.proximity_denominator: projected traversed route length in metres
analysis.coverage_method: entire centerline and conservative full buffer containment; no sampling-only or area-percentage threshold

sidewalk.interpretation: Any usable sidewalk-family value is tag availability only; no inferred sidewalk presence, side, continuity or walkability.

shops_and_businesses.interpretation: Sensitivity scenario for flagged pairs only; not bounds on true physical facilities.

healthcare_facilities.interpretation: Sensitivity scenario for flagged pairs only; not bounds on true physical facilities.

police_stations.interpretation: Sensitivity scenario for flagged pairs only; not bounds on true physical facilities.

evidence_confidence.scope: Evidence completeness, never personal safety or calibrated probability

route_context.overlap_rule: Category memberships and proximity percentages overlap. Do not sum them. Unknown-tag road proximity may overlap yes/no-tag road proximity.
